a115.note: 模封後曲率反映材料與固化歷史。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a115.noteEn: Post-mold curvature depends on material and cure history. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a119.note: 嵌入晶粒的接觸開口與樹脂層要可追溯。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a119.noteEn: Trace contact openings and resin layers in embedded die. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a126.note: 有機中介層的材料各向異性不可忽略。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a126.noteEn: Organic-interposer anisotropy matters. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a127.note: 玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。此 BGA 截面僅示意接點與基板位置，不能確認其核心材料是玻璃。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a127.noteEn: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification. This BGA section locates joints and substrate but does not establish a glass-core material. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a128.note: ABF 增層依賴介電層及微孔的連續品質。此 BGA 截面不能辨識樹脂化學成分，也不能確認使用 ABF 材料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a128.noteEn: ABF build-up depends on dielectric and microvia quality. This BGA section does not identify resin chemistry or establish the use of ABF. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a133.note: 封裝供電完整性包含頻率相關阻抗。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a133.noteEn: Package power integrity involves frequency-dependent impedance. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a134.note: 訊號完整性包含串音與返回電流。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a134.noteEn: Signal integrity includes crosstalk and return current. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a136.note: 寄生參數與激發頻率及參考平面有關。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a136.noteEn: Parasitics depend on frequency and reference planes. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a137.note: 去耦電容的 ESL 與放置路徑影響有效性。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a137.noteEn: ESL and placement paths limit decoupling effectiveness. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a146.note: 溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a146.noteEn: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a147.note: 吸濕量與回焊中的內部壓力是不同觀察。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a147.noteEn: Moisture uptake and reflow-induced pressure are different observations. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a149.note: 聲學回波受界面與閘門深度影響。此為實體 BGA 截面的光學照片，不是超音波 A-scan 或 C-scan 檢測資料。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
a149.noteEn: Acoustic echoes depend on interfaces and gate depth. This optical photograph of a physical BGA section is not ultrasonic A-scan or C-scan data. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

a006.note: 以矽晶圓外觀認識基板尺度；這張表面照片無法判定是否為 SOI，也看不到埋入氧化層。SOI 層次請看本課原創截面圖。
a006.noteEn: Use the wafer to orient substrate scale. This surface photograph cannot identify SOI or reveal a buried oxide; use the course cross-section for the layer structure.

a016.note: 晶圓是雷射退火的處理對象；本照片沒有雷射設備、溫度分布或摻雜活化資料，不能由顏色判定退火結果。
a016.noteEn: The wafer provides substrate context for laser annealing. No laser tool, temperature field or dopant-activation data is pictured; colour cannot establish an annealing result.

a024.note: 以完整晶圓對照課內 CFET 奈米截面的尺度差距；照片不是 imec 的 CFET 樣品，也不能辨認上下互補電晶體。
a024.noteEn: Compare wafer scale with the course CFET nanoscale cross-section. This is not an imec CFET sample and does not reveal stacked complementary transistors.

a027.note: 晶圓表面提供製造尺度的起點；照片沒有可驗證的技術節點資訊，不可標成次二奈米製程實拍。
a027.noteEn: The wafer surface introduces manufacturing scale. No verifiable node information is available for this image; it is not a photograph of a sub-2-nm process.

a038.note: 由晶圓上重複晶粒辨認圖案複製的尺度；OPC 修正形狀遠小於照片解析度，本圖不能驗證 OPC 成敗。
a038.noteEn: Repeated die patterns introduce the scale of pattern replication. OPC corrections are far below this photograph’s resolution; this image cannot validate OPC.

a039.note: 晶圓是成像圖案最終轉移的載體；照片沒有光罩、反向微影目標函數或模擬空中影像。請搭配本課計算流程圖。
a039.noteEn: The wafer is the substrate onto which imaging patterns are transferred. No mask, inverse-lithography objective function or simulated aerial image is pictured; use the course computation diagram.

a047.note: 晶圓照片提供電子束寫入載體的尺度背景；沒有顯示電子束柱、曝光光阻或寫入解析度。
a047.noteEn: The wafer photograph provides substrate-scale context for electron-beam writing. It does not show an electron column, exposed resist or writing resolution.

a067.note: 晶圓表面外觀作為平坦化與後續圖案製作的背景；這不是 CMP 加工中照片，光亮外觀也不能代替平坦度量測。
a067.noteEn: The wafer surface provides context for planarization and subsequent patterning. CMP is not in progress, and a reflective appearance cannot replace flatness measurement.

a068.note: 以晶圓作為漿料與磨粒作用的基板背景；照片看不到磨粒粒徑、分散性、化學組成或 CMP 去除率。
a068.noteEn: The wafer provides substrate context for slurry and abrasive action. The image reveals no abrasive size, dispersion, chemistry or CMP removal rate.

a106.note: 整片接合要同時管理局部對準及全域形變。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a106.noteEn: Whole-wafer bonding combines local alignment and global deformation. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a109.note: 暫時膠層提供機械支撐但必須能移除。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a109.noteEn: A temporary adhesive supports a wafer but must be removable. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a110.note: 背磨厚度與次表面損傷要分開管理。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a110.noteEn: Control remaining thickness separately from subsurface damage. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a111.note: 隱形切割的改質層在晶片內部。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a111.noteEn: Stealth dicing modifies material inside the wafer. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a117.note: 面板尺度的形變不能直接套用晶圓補償。晶圓照片只供圓形基材與尺度比較，不是面板級封裝製程的實拍。 辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a117.noteEn: Panel deformation is not automatically corrected by wafer models. The wafer photo provides circular-substrate/scale context, not footage of panel-level packaging. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a123.note: 背面露出有矽殘留與過度去除兩種風險。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
a123.noteEn: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

a022.note: ALD 研究設備用來連結共形薄膜與三維元件的概念；不是 FinFET 截面，也不表示這台設備製造過本課的元件。
a022.noteEn: This research ALD system links conformal-film processing to three-dimensional devices. It is not a FinFET cross-section or evidence that this instrument fabricated the course device.

a028.note: ALD 腔體是共形沉積的代表設備；本照片未顯示奈米片內側間隔層，也不保證特定材料或選擇性配方。
a028.noteEn: The ALD chamber represents conformal deposition equipment. It does not show a nanosheet inner spacer or establish a particular material or selective-process recipe.

a044.note: ALD 研究設備對應四重圖案化中的共形間隔層概念；照片沒有四重線條圖案，也不能證明週期控制或缺陷表現。
a044.noteEn: The research ALD system supports the conformal-spacer concept used in quadruple patterning. It shows neither a quadrupled line pattern nor measured pitch control or defect performance.

a072.note: ALD 是 3D NAND 高深寬比薄膜研究的相關製程；這是通用研究設備，不是 NAND 堆疊截面或記憶孔實拍。
a072.noteEn: ALD is relevant to high-aspect-ratio films in 3D NAND. This is general research equipment, not a NAND-stack cross-section or a memory-hole micrograph.

a073.note: 以 ALD 設備認識介電薄膜形成的硬體背景；照片沒有電荷捕捉層、穿隧氧化層或保持時間測試結果。
a073.noteEn: The ALD system gives hardware context for dielectric-film formation. It does not show a charge-trap layer, tunnel oxide or retention-test result.

a076.note: ALD 設備對應氧化物薄膜的可控沉積概念；沒有顯示電阻切換、導電細絲或 ReRAM 耐久性量測。
a076.noteEn: The ALD tool supports the concept of controlled oxide-film deposition. It does not show resistive switching, conductive filaments or ReRAM endurance measurements.

a090.note: ALD 研究設備提供薄膜成長的比較背景；不是大面積顯示面板產線或 TFT 背板實拍，也不能直接套用晶圓設備的均勻性。
a090.noteEn: This research ALD tool provides comparative thin-film-growth context. It is not a large-area display line or a TFT backplane; wafer-tool uniformity cannot be transferred directly to panel processing.

assets.title: Quilt Packaging 接點及回焊焊料顯微影像

a103.note: 銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a103.noteEn: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a104.note: 壓力、溫度與接合時間共同影響接點。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a104.noteEn: Pressure, temperature and time jointly affect a joint. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a105.note: 銅對銅接合不依賴回焊焊料。圖中為 Quilt Packaging 焊料互連的比較照片，不是直接 Cu-Cu 或介電／銅混合接合界面。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a105.noteEn: Copper-to-copper bonding is distinct from solder reflow. This Quilt Packaging solder interconnect is a comparison image, not a direct Cu-Cu or dielectric/Cu hybrid-bond interface. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a118.note: 種子層、電鍍及去種子層共同決定線路。圖中為 Quilt Packaging 焊料互連，不是 RDL 金屬線的截面。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a118.noteEn: Seed, plating and seed removal jointly define routing. This shows Quilt Packaging solder interconnects, not an RDL metal-line cross-section. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a122.note: TSV 金屬填充不能由表面封口判斷。圖中為外露焊料互連，不顯示 TSV 孔內部或其填充完整性。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a122.noteEn: A sealed TSV top does not prove void-free fill. Exposed solder interconnects do not show TSV interiors or fill integrity. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a148.note: 焊點壽命模型必須對應正確應變指標。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a148.noteEn: Solder-life models require the appropriate strain metric. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

a150.note: X 光投影重疊不能當作三維斷層。此為 Quilt Packaging 的顯微照片，不是 X 光 CT 切片或斷層重建。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
a150.noteEn: Overlapping X-ray projections are not 3D tomography. This Quilt Packaging microscopy image is not an X-ray CT slice or tomographic reconstruction. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

assets.author: NASA/GRC/Quentin Schwinn
assets.sourceDescription: Pictured is a model to study the ice collection on struts in jet engines during flight. assets.title: X-57 馬達控制器振動試驗
assets.titleEn: X-57 cruise motor controller vibration test
assets.author: NASA/Ken Ulbrich
assets.sourceDescription: A cruise motor controller for the X-57 Maxwell, NASA's first all-electric X-plane, undergoes vibration testing at NASA Armstrong Flight Research Center's environmental lab. The cruise motor controller is exposed to two levels of vibration on three different axes, helping NASA to examine the integrity of the controller for flight conditions. The cruise motor controller will be a critical component for providing power to X-57's motors when the aircraft takes to the skies in 2020.

assets.sourceDescription: NASA's all-electric X-57 project team installed two 400-pound lithium-ion battery packs in the cabin of the plane in 2022 at NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center in California. assets.title: 風扇聲學機匣處理試驗
assets.author: Marvin Smith
assets.sourceDescription: Title: W-8 Fan Acoustic Casing Treatment Test on the Source Diagnostic Test Rotor Alone Hardware Program: Advanced Air Vehicles Program (AAVP) Project: Advanced Air Transport Technology (AATT) Sub-project: Aircraft Noise Reduction (ANR)   Weekly Highlight: ·         Acoustic Casing Treatment Testing Completed in the W-8 Single Stage Axial Compressor Facility: Testing of Acoustic Casing Treatments on the Source Diagnostic Test (SDT) rotor alone hardware which had begun in early January was completed on Thursday, February 16th. Four different over-the-rotor acoustic casing treatment concepts were tested along with two baseline configurations. Testing included steady-aerodynamic measurements of fan performance, hotfilm turbulence measurements, and inlet acoustic measurements with an in-duct array. These measurements will be used to assess the aerodynamic and acoustic impact of fan acoustic casing treatments on a high bypass ratio fan at TRL 3. This test was the last of 3 planned tests of potential over-the-rotor acoustic casing treatments. The first treatment test was completed in the Normal Incidence Tube (NIT) at Langley Research Center (LaRC) in Fall 2015 and the second was completed on the Advanced Noise Control Fan (ANCF) in the Aero-Acoustic Propulsion Laboratory (AAPL) in Winter 2016. This work is supported by the Aircraft Noise Reduction (ANR) subproject of the Advanced Air Transport Technology (AATT) Project. (POC: LTV/ Rick Bozak 3-5160)

assets.title: 安靜電動引擎聲學試驗室
assets.titleEn: Quiet Electric Engine experiment in an acoustical laboratory
assets.author: NASA/GRC/Sara Lowthian-Hanna
assets.sourceDescription: The Quiet Electric Engine V1 (QUEEN V1) experiment that was performed in the NASA GRC Acoustical Testing Laboratory (ATL). Equipment is installed in the anechoic chamber and in the adjacent control room. In response to the pervasive health and environmental problems associated with aviation noise and air pollution, NASA’s Quiet Electric Engine (QUEEN) team is working to increase the peace and quiet in the world by researching ways to make engines for large single-aisle aircraft safer, cleaner, and quieter.

assets.title: 研究機光纖感測器地面驗證
assets.author: NASA/Tony Landis
assets.sourceDescription: NASA engineer Larry Hudson and Ikhana ground crew member James Smith work on a ground validation test with new fiber optic sensors that led to validation flights on the Ikhana aircraft. NASA Dryden Flight Research Center is evaluating an advanced fiber optic-based sensing technology installed on the wings of NASA's Ikhana aircraft. The fiber optic system measures and displays the shape of the aircraft's wings in flight. There are other potential safety applications for the technology, such as vehicle structural health monitoring. If an aircraft structure can be monitored with sensors and a computer can manipulate flight control surfaces to compensate for stresses on the wings, structural control can be established to prevent situations that might otherwise result in a loss of control.

photoHotspots.title: 綠色閥門手輪
photoHotspots.text: 可見手輪、閥桿方向及其連接管路。先沿管路追蹤上下游，再討論閥門如何影響阻力；照片不提供閥位、流體種類或允許操作順序。
photoHotspots.textEn: Identify the handwheel, stem direction and connected piping. Trace upstream and downstream before discussing flow resistance. The image does not specify valve position, fluid identity or an authorized operating sequence.

photoHotspots.title: 螺栓固定的管件蓋板
photoHotspots.text: 綠色圓形蓋板周圍有多個螺栓，位於直立管件上。觀察接合面與可拆卸結構；不能由外觀判定內部構造、墊片材質或是否已隔離壓力。
photoHotspots.textEn: A green circular cover with several bolts sits on the vertical fitting. Observe the joint and removable construction. Internal geometry, gasket material and pressure isolation cannot be determined from appearance.

photoHotspots.title: 下方泵浦與馬達組
photoHotspots.text: 底部可見藍色泵殼連著黑色馬達，兩者固定在共同底座上。把電力輸入、軸功率與流體輸出畫成能量路徑；流量和揚程仍需量測資料。
photoHotspots.textEn: A blue pump housing connects to a black motor on a shared base. Sketch the path from electrical input through shaft power to fluid output. Flow and head still require measurement data.

assets.hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.

photoHotspots.title: 中央黃色機組外殼
photoHotspots.text: 中央機組的黃色外殼、固定支承及周圍通道可清楚辨認。先描述可見配置，再查原廠資料辨識內部部件；外觀不足以推定功率、效率或維修狀態。
photoHotspots.textEn: The central yellow housing, supports and surrounding access space are visible. Describe the layout before consulting manufacturer documentation for internal parts. Appearance alone does not establish power, efficiency or maintenance condition.

photoHotspots.title: 上方纜線束與支承
photoHotspots.text: 多條粗纜線從上方支承區彎向機組。觀察纜線路徑與機械通道的分隔，思考電氣、結構和維修空間如何協調；照片不能用來判定電壓或載流量。
photoHotspots.textEn: Several thick cables curve from overhead supports toward the machinery. Observe separation between cable routing and access space. Electrical, structural and maintenance needs share this area; voltage and ampacity cannot be inferred from the photo.

photoHotspots.title: 柱旁圓形指示錶
photoHotspots.text: 白色柱旁可見紅框圓形指示錶。先辨認錶面、指針和安裝位置；這張影像不足以可靠讀出單位或數值，因此不要將它填入教學算例作為實測輸入。
photoHotspots.textEn: A red-rimmed round dial is mounted beside the white column. Locate its face, pointer and mounting position. Units and readings are not sufficiently clear here, so do not enter a guessed value as a measured input.

photoHotspots.title: 水下影像顯示幕
photoHotspots.text: 大型螢幕顯示照明下的水下景象。先區分影像中的物件、相機視角及畫面外未知區域；單張照片不能提供當前深度、距離或可通行範圍。
photoHotspots.textEn: The large monitor shows an illuminated underwater view. Separate visible objects, camera viewpoint and unseen areas. A photograph does not provide current depth, range or traversable clearance.

photoHotspots.title: 狀態資料顯示幕
photoHotspots.text: 下排螢幕同時有數字、方向圖與欄位。練習先找出各欄位的名稱、單位及時間，再討論它們與影像是否同步；不要把照片上的舊數字當作即時遙測。
photoHotspots.textEn: The lower display combines numbers, direction graphics and fields. Identify labels, units and timestamps before comparing them with video. Numbers captured in the photo are not live telemetry.

photoHotspots.title: 發光按鍵操作區
photoHotspots.text: 螢幕下方可見多排發光按鍵。把實體輸入、軟體命令與畫面回饋畫成流程圖；照片無法確定每一個按鍵的實際功能，點此熱點只開啟說明。
photoHotspots.textEn: Rows of illuminated controls are visible below the monitor. Draw the relationship between physical input, software command and displayed feedback. Individual button functions cannot be established from the image; this hotspot only opens an explanation.

assets.hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.

photoHotspots.title: 左側測繪資料視窗
photoHotspots.text: 左螢幕可見彩色條帶和矩形選取框。先說明選取範圍與資料顯示的差別，再討論品質檢查；這張照片沒有提供可下載的原始聲納紀錄。
photoHotspots.textEn: The left monitor shows a colored strip and rectangular selection boxes. Distinguish a selected region from the underlying data display before discussing quality control. This photo supplies no raw sonar record.

photoHotspots.title: 右側彩色測深點雲
photoHotspots.text: 右螢幕顯示由許多彩色點構成的海床形貌。顏色需要搭配圖例和座標系解讀；不能單憑截圖將某一顏色換算成深度或斷定離群點必須刪除。
photoHotspots.textEn: The right monitor displays seabed form as many colored points. Interpret color with its legend and coordinate system. A screenshot alone cannot convert color to depth or justify deleting an apparent outlier.

photoHotspots.title: 資料編輯鍵盤
photoHotspots.text: 桌面鍵盤與滑鼠是資料檢視和標註的輸入設備。課內練習應保留原始資料、處理紀錄及回復方法，再比較處理前後；這個熱點不會操作照片中的工作站。
photoHotspots.textEn: The keyboard and mouse provide input for viewing and annotating data. Preserve raw data, processing history and a way to revert before comparing results. This hotspot does not control the pictured workstation.

photoHotspots.title: 直列類比指示錶
photoHotspots.text: 上方直列錶面搭配設備名稱與量測項目標籤。先逐一辨認量測項目與單位，避免把溫度、壓力及轉速混用；照片上的讀值不作為當前船況。
photoHotspots.textEn: The upper vertical indicators have equipment and measurement labels. Identify each quantity and unit before comparing temperature, pressure or speed. Their photographed readings do not represent the vessel’s current condition.

photoHotspots.title: 機艙車鐘刻度盤
photoHotspots.text: 下方圓盤可見STOP、SLOW等分段文字，用來表達車令等級。比較離散命令與實際量測值的差別；車令標示不是螺槳轉速或航速的直接讀值。
photoHotspots.textEn: The lower dial has discrete labels such as STOP and SLOW for engine orders. Compare discrete commands with measured responses. An order label is not a direct propeller-speed or vessel-speed measurement.

photoHotspots.title: 右側操縱桿
photoHotspots.text: 右側可見黑色握柄與金屬行程槽。觀察操作輸入的機械形式，將它與上方指示錶的回饋分開；照片未確認此操縱桿的聯鎖、有效控制站或實際功能。
photoHotspots.textEn: A black handle sits in a metal travel slot on the right. Separate this mechanical input from indicator feedback above. Interlocks, the active control station and the lever’s exact function are not established by the photo.

photoHotspots.title: 環列採水瓶
photoHotspots.text: 前方編號9的長筒是環列採水瓶之一。沿著瓶身找出上、下端及支架；採水瓶保存水樣，不能把瓶身直接當作溫度或鹽度探頭。照片沒有提供水樣深度或分析結果。
photoHotspots.textEn: The numbered cylinder at the front is one of the rosette sampling bottles. Trace its body, ends and supports. A bottle retains a water sample; it is not itself a temperature or salinity probe. This image provides no sample depth or analysis result.

photoHotspots.title: 頂部吊掛連接
photoHotspots.text: 可見鋼索連到裝置頂部金屬吊掛構件。先沿受力路徑找出吊索、連接點與外框，再把它們與資料纜線區分。照片不能證明吊具額定能力或當前檢查狀態。
photoHotspots.textEn: The cable meets a metal lifting connection above the rosette. Trace the visible lifting path and distinguish it from data wiring. The photograph does not establish lifting capacity or inspection status.

photoHotspots.title: 白色環形保護框
photoHotspots.text: 白色環形外框包圍採水瓶與底部裝置。觀察它與船舷及甲板的相對位置，理解回收空間為何需要事先規劃；這是觀察任務，不提供真實吊放指令。
photoHotspots.textEn: The white circular frame surrounds the bottles and lower equipment. Observe its position relative to the deck and ship side to understand why recovery space is planned. This observation task provides no real deployment commands.

assets.hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.

photoHotspots.title: 水中的白色船模
photoHotspots.titleEn: White hull model in the water
photoHotspots.text: 觀察船模輪廓、水線附近和水面反射。這是縮尺船模的實拍；若要比較模型與實船，還需知道尺度、吃水、速度及相似條件，不能只按照片長度換算阻力。
photoHotspots.textEn: Observe the model outline, waterline region and reflection. Comparing model and full-scale vessel requires scale, draft, speed and similarity assumptions. Resistance cannot be obtained by scaling image lengths.

photoHotspots.title: 船模上方垂直連接件
photoHotspots.text: 船模上方可見垂直連接構件連到上方裝置。追蹤幾何連接關係，將支承／拖曳結構和實際力感測器區分；照片不足以確認感測器型式或校正係數。
photoHotspots.textEn: A vertical member connects the model to the apparatus above. Trace the geometry while distinguishing supports or tow connections from a force sensor. Sensor type and calibration are not established by this photograph.

photoHotspots.title: 水槽上方紅色橫架
photoHotspots.text: 紅色橫架跨在水槽上方。把船模、水槽和上方拖曳構架放入同一系統圖，討論定速區段為何重要；此靜態影像沒有提供拖車速度或試驗時序。
photoHotspots.textEn: The red structure spans above the tank. Place model, tank and towing structure in a system diagram and explain the need for a steady-speed segment. This still image provides neither carriage speed nor a test timeline.

assets.hotspotAnnotationMethod: Coordinates selected after visual inspection of each complete delivery photograph; explanatory overlays, not automatic instrument recognition, sensor readings or image-pixel edits.

c151.note: Newcastle及UCL實拍為不同學校的船模／拖曳水槽；USGS實拍為流速儀器校準水槽，不是同一場實驗，也不能由照片取得阻力數據。
c151.noteEn: Newcastle and UCL photographs show separate model/towing laboratories; USGS shows a water-velocity instrument calibration tank. They do not document one shared experiment or supply resistance measurements.

The model-hull photo supports waterline and hull observation; it does not show an inclining experiment or measurable centre-of-gravity/GM data.

photoHotspots.title: 水槽自由液面
photoHotspots.text: 中央水面反射上方鋼架，讓實體與倒影容易混淆。先辨認自由液面，再討論造波、反射和水槽邊界如何影響模型試驗；照片沒有顯示可量測的波高序列。
photoHotspots.textEn: The water reflects the overhead frame, making objects and reflections easy to confuse. Locate the free surface before discussing waves, reflections and tank boundaries. No measurable wave-height time series is provided.

photoHotspots.title: 透明側壁與邊框
photoHotspots.text: 透明側壁及其上緣沿水槽延伸。觀察可視範圍及側壁位置，思考有限水槽寬度與深度如何限制試驗；影像透視不能代替校準尺寸。
photoHotspots.textEn: The transparent sidewall and rim extend along the tank. Observe visibility and boundaries when considering finite width and depth. Image perspective does not replace calibrated dimensions.

photoHotspots.title: 跨槽鋼構支承
photoHotspots.text: 深色鋼梁橫跨水槽，上方與側邊還有其他支承構件。將固定結構、可能移動的試驗裝置及水域分層標示；單張照片無法確認所有構件的運動自由度。
photoHotspots.textEn: A dark steel beam spans the tank with additional supports above and alongside. Distinguish fixed structure, test apparatus and water. A single photograph cannot establish every component’s degrees of freedom.

name: 系統履歷與構型模型
Configuration and system-history model
body: 本課「經國號與航空製造概念」：從構型與序號辨識同名零件差異；課內資料是教學記錄，不是核准維修工卡。
For IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts: Use configuration and serial records to distinguish similarly named parts; lesson records are not approved maintenance task cards.

name: 狀態與量測證據站
Condition and evidence station
body: 本課「經國號與航空製造概念」：比較時間趨勢與基準狀態，先排除感測漂移、漏項與記錄錯置。
For IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts: Compare trends and baseline condition after checking sensor drift, missing data and record mismatch.

name: 故障假設比較台
Fault-hypothesis comparison bench
body: 本課「經國號與航空製造概念」：一次比較兩個故障假設，挑能區分原因的資料；相關性不能代替故障確認。
For IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts: Compare two fault hypotheses and choose discriminating evidence; correlation does not confirm a fault.

name: 工卡與變更追溯紀錄
Task-card and change-traceability log
body: 本課「經國號與航空製造概念」：保留資料來源、版本與覆核結果，標示每次輔助步驟與未解決的不確定性。
For IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts: Retain provenance, versions and review outcomes, including assisted steps and unresolved uncertainty.

name: 旋翼盤與槳葉模型
Rotor disk and blade model
body: 本課「阿帕契案例與旋翼機原理」：辨識旋翼盤、槳根與槳尖，區分定常動量模型和實際非均勻尾流。
For Apache Context and Rotorcraft Principles: Identify disk, blade root and tip; distinguish steady momentum theory from a real nonuniform wake.

name: 推力與轉速量測
Thrust and rotational-speed sensors
body: 本課「阿帕契案例與旋翼機原理」：核對轉速的 rpm 與 rad/s，將力矩、功率和推力視為不同量測量。
For Apache Context and Rotorcraft Principles: Check rpm versus rad/s and distinguish torque, power and thrust as separate measured quantities.

name: 盤面負荷參數台
Disk-loading parameter bench
body: 本課「阿帕契案例與旋翼機原理」：在虛擬模型改變盤面積或推力，先估算誘導功率趨勢；不提供實機旋翼調整值。
For Apache Context and Rotorcraft Principles: Vary virtual disk area or thrust and predict induced-power trends; no real-rotor adjustments are supplied.

name: 推力／功率紀錄
Thrust/power log
body: 本課「阿帕契案例與旋翼機原理」：保存推力、密度、盤面積與效率假設，說明槳尖損失、旋流和前飛的影響。
For Apache Context and Rotorcraft Principles: Save thrust, density, area and efficiency assumptions; discuss tip loss, swirl and forward flight.

name: 機體系統剖面模型
Airframe system model
body: 本課「Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程」：先辨識機身、機翼、尾翼與主要承載路徑；用課內流程圖追蹤系統接口，不把代表照片當成原廠內部設計。
For Airbus A350 composite airliner systems: Identify fuselage, wings, tail and load paths. Trace interfaces using the course diagram; reference photography is not an OEM internal design.

name: 重量與位置量測站
Mass and position station
body: 本課「Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程」：記下每個質量及其基準站位，保持同一座標原點；外觀照片不能提供可靠重量或重心。
For Airbus A350 composite airliner systems: Record masses and stations from one reference origin; photography cannot provide reliable mass or centre of gravity.

name: 載重配置台
Load-configuration bench
body: 本課「Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程」：僅在教學模型改變載重或幾何參數，先預測重心和結構反應方向，再比較算例。
For Airbus A350 composite airliner systems: Change loads or geometry in the teaching model, predict centre-of-gravity and structural trends, then compare calculations.

name: 系統整合紀錄

body: 本課「Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程」：保存假設、單位、結果與代表影像標題，列出尚缺的機型資料。

For Concorde supersonic airliner engineering history: Identify model and tunnel boundaries: airfoil, support and walls. Distinguish real tunnel images from the idealized lesson airfoil.

body: 本課「Concorde 超音速客機工程史」：讀取教學壓差或升阻力，先確認零點、量程與參考面積；不能直接從照片量出升力。
For Concorde supersonic airliner engineering history: Read teaching pressure differences or forces; check zero, range and reference area. Lift cannot be measured directly from the photograph.

name: 來流與攻角控制
Inflow and angle-of-attack control
body: 本課「Concorde 超音速客機工程史」：一次只改攻角或速度，觀察動壓平方律；失速後不延伸線性升力模型。
For Concorde supersonic airliner engineering history: Change only angle or speed, observe the dynamic-pressure square law, and do not extend linear lift beyond stall.

name: 升阻曲線紀錄
Lift-drag curve log
body: 本課「Concorde 超音速客機工程史」：記錄雷諾數、馬赫數與模型限制，對照第二種量測而非只看曲線平滑。

body: 本課「航空燃油系統安全概念」：保存批次、來源、假設與缺少的試驗證據；本課不進行實際燃料混配或放行。

name: 視景與運動平台模型
Visual and motion-platform model
body: 本課「飛行模擬器運動平台」：區分窗外合成視景、實體操作件與運動提示；真實的照片可以拍攝模擬畫面，仍不是飛行外景。
For Flight-simulator motion platforms: Distinguish synthetic views, physical controls and motion cues; a real photograph of a simulator is not an external flight view.

name: 延遲與姿態量測站
Latency and pose station
body: 本課「飛行模擬器運動平台」：量測指令至畫面的時間差並比較視景與運動同步，不以幀率代替端到端延遲。
For Flight-simulator motion platforms: Measure command-to-image delay and visual-motion alignment; frame rate is not end-to-end latency.

name: 視角與提示參數台
View and cue parameter bench
body: 本課「飛行模擬器運動平台」：調整教學視場或濾波參數，記錄操作感受與數值反應，維持同一任務條件。
For Flight-simulator motion platforms: Adjust teaching field of view or filtering; log experience and numerical response under the same task conditions.

name: 人因觀察紀錄
Human-factors observation log
body: 本課「飛行模擬器運動平台」：記錄任務完成、誤操作與取消，將輔助完成和自主完成分開。
For Flight-simulator motion platforms: Log completion, errors and cancellations, separating assisted from independent performance.

name: 視景與運動平台模型
Visual and motion-platform model
body: 本課「全動式飛行模擬器視景」：區分窗外合成視景、實體操作件與運動提示；真實的照片可以拍攝模擬畫面，仍不是飛行外景。

name: 系統履歷與構型模型
Configuration and system-history model
body: 本課「航空維修數位工卡」：從構型與序號辨識同名零件差異；課內資料是教學記錄，不是核准維修工卡。
For Digital aircraft maintenance work cards: Use configuration and serial records to distinguish similarly named parts; lesson records are not approved maintenance task cards.

name: 狀態與量測證據站
Condition and evidence station
body: 本課「航空維修數位工卡」：比較時間趨勢與基準狀態，先排除感測漂移、漏項與記錄錯置。
For Digital aircraft maintenance work cards: Compare trends and baseline condition after checking sensor drift, missing data and record mismatch.

name: 故障假設比較台
Fault-hypothesis comparison bench
body: 本課「航空維修數位工卡」：一次比較兩個故障假設，挑能區分原因的資料；相關性不能代替故障確認。
For Digital aircraft maintenance work cards: Compare two fault hypotheses and choose discriminating evidence; correlation does not confirm a fault.

name: 工卡與變更追溯紀錄
Task-card and change-traceability log
body: 本課「航空維修數位工卡」：保留資料來源、版本與覆核結果，標示每次輔助步驟與未解決的不確定性。
For Digital aircraft maintenance work cards: Retain provenance, versions and review outcomes, including assisted steps and unresolved uncertainty.

name: 系統履歷與構型模型
Configuration and system-history model
body: 本課「民航機適航取證流程」：從構型與序號辨識同名零件差異；課內資料是教學記錄，不是核准維修工卡。
For Civil-aircraft certification workflow: Use configuration and serial records to distinguish similarly named parts; lesson records are not approved maintenance task cards.

name: 狀態與量測證據站
Condition and evidence station
body: 本課「民航機適航取證流程」：比較時間趨勢與基準狀態，先排除感測漂移、漏項與記錄錯置。

name: 事件與需求追溯紀錄
Event and requirements log
body: 本課「飛機重量與平衡管理」：將每個測試輸出連到需求與合成故障情境，保留未通過的案例。
For Aircraft weight and balance management: Link outputs to requirements and synthetic faults, retaining failed cases.

name: 翼樑與試驗夾具
Wing spar and test fixture
body: 本課「飛機地面振動試驗」：沿夾具追蹤支承與載重傳遞，標示自由體圖的邊界；試驗照片不能證明所有機型具有相同安全裕度。
For Aircraft ground-vibration testing: Trace supports and load transfer through the fixture and mark free-body boundaries; a test photograph cannot establish margins for other aircraft.

name: 應變規與位移感測器
Strain and displacement sensors
body: 本課「飛機地面振動試驗」：比較應變與位移，先查零飄、方向與溫度補償。區分局部應變和整體撓度。
For Aircraft ground-vibration testing: Compare strain and displacement after checking zero drift, orientation and temperature compensation; distinguish local strain from overall deflection.

name: 分配載重致動器
Distributed-load actuators
body: 本課「飛機地面振動試驗」：在教學算例逐級改變載重，保持支承條件；非線性或損傷出現時不能外推線性剛度。
For Aircraft ground-vibration testing: Increment teaching loads with unchanged supports; do not extrapolate linear stiffness into nonlinearity or damage.

name: 載重—變形紀錄
Load-deformation log
body: 本課「飛機地面振動試驗」：儲存載入、卸載與殘餘變形，說明哪些證據足以區分感測錯誤與結構變化。
For Aircraft ground-vibration testing: Save loading, unloading and residual deformation; identify evidence separating sensor error from structural change.

name: 配電與電動推進模型
Power-distribution and propulsion model
body: 本課「飛機電磁相容性驗證」：辨識電源、保護、匯流排與負載，分清正常供電和故障隔離路徑。
For Aircraft electromagnetic compatibility: Identify sources, protection, buses and loads, separating normal supply from fault-isolation paths.

name: 電流／溫度量測站
Current/temperature station
body: 本課「飛機電磁相容性驗證」：核對量測位置與正負號，區分電池標稱能量與實際可用能量。
For Aircraft electromagnetic compatibility: Check measurement points and signs, and distinguish nominal battery energy from usable energy.

name: 負載與散熱參數台
Load and cooling parameter bench
body: 本課「飛機電磁相容性驗證」：只改教學負載或熱阻，觀察I²R損失與溫升；此介面不接觸高壓設備。
For Aircraft electromagnetic compatibility: Change teaching load or thermal resistance and observe I²R loss and temperature rise; this interface never controls high-voltage equipment.

name: 功率與熱量紀錄
Power and thermal log
body: 本課「飛機電磁相容性驗證」：保存效率、時間、溫度和容量假設，將資料與電池老化等未建模因素分開。
For Aircraft electromagnetic compatibility: Save efficiency, duration, temperature and capacity assumptions; separate model output from unmodeled ageing.

name: 聲源與吸音環境
Source and acoustic environment
body: 本課「民航機噪音認證概念」：辨識聲源、吸音牆及反射路徑；照片只提供設備情境，不代表這次模型的實際噪音。
For Civil-aircraft noise certification concepts: Identify source, absorbent walls and reflections; photography provides context rather than measured noise for the lesson model.

name: 麥克風與校正器
Microphones and calibrator
body: 本課「民航機噪音認證概念」：先查麥克風校正、方向和頻率範圍，將背景聲與被測聲分開。
For Civil-aircraft noise certification concepts: Check microphone calibration, orientation and bandwidth; separate background sound from the measured source.

name: 頻率與量測距離台
Frequency and distance bench
body: 本課「民航機噪音認證概念」：在教學模型變更距離或兩個聲源強度，使用對數相加，不能直接相加分貝。
For Civil-aircraft noise certification concepts: Vary teaching distance or source levels using logarithmic addition, never direct addition of decibels.

name: 頻譜與背景音紀錄
Spectrum and background log
body: 本課「民航機噪音認證概念」：保留未加權頻譜、量測位置及處理條件，說明自由場假設何時失效。
For Civil-aircraft noise certification concepts: Keep unweighted spectra, positions and processing conditions; state when free-field assumptions fail.

name: 翼樑與試驗夾具
Wing spar and test fixture
body: 本課「飛機座椅動態安全試驗」：沿夾具追蹤支承與載重傳遞，標示自由體圖的邊界；試驗照片不能證明所有機型具有相同安全裕度。
For Aircraft-seat dynamic safety testing: Trace supports and load transfer through the fixture and mark free-body boundaries; a test photograph cannot establish margins for other aircraft.

name: 應變規與位移感測器
Strain and displacement sensors
body: 本課「飛機座椅動態安全試驗」：比較應變與位移，先查零飄、方向與溫度補償。區分局部應變和整體撓度。
For Aircraft-seat dynamic safety testing: Compare strain and displacement after checking zero drift, orientation and temperature compensation; distinguish local strain from overall deflection.

name: 分配載重致動器
Distributed-load actuators
body: 本課「飛機座椅動態安全試驗」：在教學算例逐級改變載重，保持支承條件；非線性或損傷出現時不能外推線性剛度。
For Aircraft-seat dynamic safety testing: Increment teaching loads with unchanged supports; do not extrapolate linear stiffness into nonlinearity or damage.

For Aircraft-seat dynamic safety testing: Save loading, unloading and residual deformation; identify evidence separating sensor error from structural change.

name: 座艙與乘員路徑模型
Cabin and occupant-path model
body: 本課「航空緊急疏散系統」：標示入口、出口與通道，將簡化疏散網路和實機核准構型分開。
For Aircraft emergency evacuation systems: Mark entry, exit and paths, separating a simplified evacuation network from an approved aircraft configuration.

name: 時間與人流觀察站
Time and flow observation station
body: 本課「航空緊急疏散系統」：記下到達、等待和通過時間，區分人流平均值與個體差異。
For Aircraft emergency evacuation systems: Record arrival, wait and passage times; distinguish average flow from individual variation.

name: 通道與提示參數台
Path and cue parameter bench
body: 本課「航空緊急疏散系統」：在教學模型改變通道容量或提示延遲，查看瓶頸轉移；不提供真實緊急程序。
For Aircraft emergency evacuation systems: Vary teaching path capacity or cue delay and observe bottleneck movement; no real emergency procedure is supplied.

name: 人因與安全案例紀錄
Human-factors case log
body: 本課「航空緊急疏散系統」：保留情境、假設與未涵蓋群體，不能用模擬達標代替適航測試。
For Aircraft emergency evacuation systems: Retain scenarios, assumptions and excluded groups; simulation performance does not replace certification tests.

name: 旋翼盤與槳葉模型
Rotor disk and blade model
body: 本課「直升機旋翼槳葉製造」：辨識旋翼盤、槳根與槳尖，區分定常動量模型和實際非均勻尾流。
For Helicopter rotor-blade manufacturing: Identify disk, blade root and tip; distinguish steady momentum theory from a real nonuniform wake.

name: 推力與轉速量測
Thrust and rotational-speed sensors
body: 本課「直升機旋翼槳葉製造」：核對轉速的 rpm 與 rad/s，將力矩、功率和推力視為不同量測量。
For Helicopter rotor-blade manufacturing: Check rpm versus rad/s and distinguish torque, power and thrust as separate measured quantities.

name: 盤面負荷參數台
Disk-loading parameter bench
body: 本課「直升機旋翼槳葉製造」：在虛擬模型改變盤面積或推力，先估算誘導功率趨勢；不提供實機旋翼調整值。
For Helicopter rotor-blade manufacturing: Vary virtual disk area or thrust and predict induced-power trends; no real-rotor adjustments are supplied.

name: 推力／功率紀錄
Thrust/power log
body: 本課「直升機旋翼槳葉製造」：保存推力、密度、盤面積與效率假設，說明槳尖損失、旋流和前飛的影響。
For Helicopter rotor-blade manufacturing: Save thrust, density, area and efficiency assumptions; discuss tip loss, swirl and forward flight.

name: 旋翼盤與槳葉模型
Rotor disk and blade model
body: 本課「直升機旋翼追蹤與平衡」：辨識旋翼盤、槳根與槳尖，區分定常動量模型和實際非均勻尾流。

For Helicopter rotor tracking and balancing: Save thrust, density, area and efficiency assumptions; discuss tip loss, swirl and forward flight.

name: 旋翼盤與槳葉模型
Rotor disk and blade model
body: 本課「直升機尾旋翼安全工程」：辨識旋翼盤、槳根與槳尖，區分定常動量模型和實際非均勻尾流。
For Helicopter tail-rotor safety engineering: Identify disk, blade root and tip; distinguish steady momentum theory from a real nonuniform wake.

name: 推力與轉速量測
Thrust and rotational-speed sensors
body: 本課「直升機尾旋翼安全工程」：核對轉速的 rpm 與 rad/s，將力矩、功率和推力視為不同量測量。
For Helicopter tail-rotor safety engineering: Check rpm versus rad/s and distinguish torque, power and thrust as separate measured quantities.

name: 盤面負荷參數台
Disk-loading parameter bench
body: 本課「直升機尾旋翼安全工程」：在虛擬模型改變盤面積或推力，先估算誘導功率趨勢；不提供實機旋翼調整值。
For Helicopter tail-rotor safety engineering: Vary virtual disk area or thrust and predict induced-power trends; no real-rotor adjustments are supplied.

name: 推力／功率紀錄
Thrust/power log
body: 本課「直升機尾旋翼安全工程」：保存推力、密度、盤面積與效率假設，說明槳尖損失、旋流和前飛的影響。
For Helicopter tail-rotor safety engineering: Save thrust, density, area and efficiency assumptions; discuss tip loss, swirl and forward flight.

name: 系統履歷與構型模型
Configuration and system-history model
body: 本課「民用無人機機架設計」：從構型與序號辨識同名零件差異；課內資料是教學記錄，不是核准維修工卡。
For Civil-drone airframe design: Use configuration and serial records to distinguish similarly named parts; lesson records are not approved maintenance task cards.

name: 狀態與量測證據站
Condition and evidence station
body: 本課「民用無人機機架設計」：比較時間趨勢與基準狀態，先排除感測漂移、漏項與記錄錯置。
For Civil-drone airframe design: Compare trends and baseline condition after checking sensor drift, missing data and record mismatch.

name: 故障假設比較台
Fault-hypothesis comparison bench
body: 本課「民用無人機機架設計」：一次比較兩個故障假設，挑能區分原因的資料；相關性不能代替故障確認。
For Civil-drone airframe design: Compare two fault hypotheses and choose discriminating evidence; correlation does not confirm a fault.

name: 工卡與變更追溯紀錄
Task-card and change-traceability log
body: 本課「民用無人機機架設計」：保留資料來源、版本與覆核結果，標示每次輔助步驟與未解決的不確定性。
For Civil-drone airframe design: Retain provenance, versions and review outcomes, including assisted steps and unresolved uncertainty.

name: 配電與電動推進模型
Power-distribution and propulsion model

For Civil-drone battery safety: Identify sources, protection, buses and loads, separating normal supply from fault-isolation paths.

name: 電流／溫度量測站

For Sustainable aviation fuel compatibility: Trace inventory, transfer, return and consumption in the teaching diagram; photos provide aircraft context rather than a complete fuel circuit.

body: 本課「航空可持續燃料相容性」：在一致溫度基準下換算體積與質量，分開流率、總量和可用存量。

body: 本課「航空可持續燃料相容性」：改變合成密度或流量假設，檢查質量守恆；相容性需要材料和規範證據，不能由顏色判定。
For Sustainable aviation fuel compatibility: Vary synthetic density or flow and check mass balance. Compatibility needs material and specification evidence and cannot be inferred from colour.

name: 來源與批次證據紀錄
Provenance and batch evidence log
body: 本課「航空可持續燃料相容性」：保存批次、來源、假設與缺少的試驗證據；本課不進行實際燃料混配或放行。

body: 本課「航空零件增材製造驗證」：辨認基準、夾持與加工順序；照片是製造與檢驗情境，不是本零件的加工配方或材料證明。

name: 尺寸與表面量測站
Dimensional and surface metrology
body: 本課「航空零件增材製造驗證」：在相同基準與溫度下比較尺寸，區分量測重複性和製程變異。
For Aerospace additive-part verification: Compare dimensions at consistent datums and temperature; separate measurement repeatability from process variation.

name: 成形／加工參數台
Forming and machining parameter bench
body: 本課「航空零件增材製造驗證」：只在合成算例變更進給、變形或熱膨脹參數，觀察誤差累積；不給現場刀具設定。
For Aerospace additive-part verification: Vary synthetic feed, deformation or thermal-expansion parameters and observe error accumulation; no live-tool settings are supplied.

name: 批次與尺寸追溯紀錄
Batch and dimensional-traceability log
body: 本課「航空零件增材製造驗證」：保存輸入材料、治具、量測與版本，以原始數據說明返工或驗證理由。
